home.READY_TO_COME: You're ready to come to Korea

today.overdue: Service request past its response time
today.reconfirm: Flight changed. Confirm the pickup again
today.needs_assignment: New service request. Assign an owner

official.needsReview: We're still confirming this with the official source. Check with your counselor before you rely on it.

cost.included: Included in your Hangyul plan at no extra cost

feedback.thanks: Thank you. This helps us improve.
feedback.gaveYes: You said this went well. Thank you!
feedback.gaveNo: You told us this didn't go well. Your team will contact you.
feedback.question: Did this go well?

emergency.title: Emergency numbers in Korea
emergency.subtitle: Free from any phone. Save them before you fly.
emergency.travel_helpline: Korea Travel Helpline (24 h, many languages)
emergency.note: In an emergency, call first. Then tell the Hangyul team.

page.title: Your first weeks in Korea
page.subtitle: From where you'll live to your residence card, one step at a time.
page.quietText: Once you're admitted, this page helps you plan where to live, your flight, airport pickup and your first weeks in Korea.
page.admittedText: You can already choose where you'll live. Flight and airport pickup open when your visa is issued.

hero.ready: You're ready to come to Korea.
hero.arrived: Welcome to Korea! You arrived on {{date}}.
hero.allSet: Everything before your flight is done.
hero.settledText: Your residence card and first-weeks steps are done. Your team is still here if you need anything.

housing.title: Confirm where you'll live
housing.why: Your address decides your airport pickup, your residence card office and your move-in date.
housing.text: Choose your housing and follow the steps on the housing page.
housing.doneText: Your housing is confirmed. You can see move-in details on the housing page.

flight.title: Add your flight
flight.why: Your pickup and your team plan around your arrival time.

pickup.title: Book your airport pickup
pickup.sub: Your pickup partner meets you at arrivals
pickup.why: A driver meets you at the airport and takes you to your room.

documents_to_carry.title: Documents to bring
documents_to_carry.text: Keep the originals in your hand luggage. You'll need them for your residence card in your first weeks:

sim_esim.title: Phone number and data (SIM or eSIM)
sim_esim.sub: What you can prepare before you fly
sim_esim.text: An eSIM or airport SIM gives you data on arrival. Some plans and most banks need your residence card, so a long-term plan usually comes later.

residence_setup.title: Your first 90 days
residence_setup.text: After you land, register for a residence card within 90 days and join National Health Insurance.

residence_card.title: Apply for your residence card
residence_card.why: The law requires it if you stay longer than 90 days. You'll need it for your bank account, phone plan and more.

health_insurance.title: Health insurance (NHIS)
health_insurance.sub: When it starts and how you pay

bank_account.title: Open a bank account
bank_account.text: Opening an account needs you in Korea in person. Hangyul can't open one for you remotely.

transport_card.title: Get a transport card
transport_card.sub: T-money for buses and the subway

flight.live: Live flight status from the airline data provider.
flight.notLive: You or your counselor enter the flight times. They are not live airline data.
flight.whenHint: Korea time, as on your ticket

pickup.title: Airport pickup
pickup.intro: Tell us who is coming and where to take you. Your team confirms the booking and the driver's details before you fly.
pickup.needFlight: Add your flight first. We plan the pickup around your arrival time.
pickup.contact: How to reach you on arrival day
pickup.handle: Your username or phone number on that app
pickup.requestsHint: e.g. a child seat, extra luggage, accessibility needs
pickup.requested: Pickup requested. Your team will confirm it.
pickup.skipped: You'll get there yourself. Here is the official information on getting from the airport:
pickup.undoSkip: I'd like a pickup after all

explain.REQUESTED: Your team is arranging your pickup. You'll see the driver's details here once it's confirmed.
explain.CONFIRMED: Your pickup is booked. The driver's name and phone number appear here before you fly.
explain.DRIVER_ASSIGNED: Your driver is assigned. They'll wait at the meeting point when you land.
explain.FLIGHT_DELAYED: Your flight is late, so the pickup time has been moved. You don't need to do anything.
explain.DRIVER_WAITING: Your driver is waiting at the meeting point.
explain.PICKED_UP: You're on your way. Welcome to Korea!
explain.NO_SHOW: The driver couldn't find you. Your team will contact you, or you can open 'Need help in Korea?'.

residence.title: Residence card
residence.groupYes: Your university applies for residence cards as a group. You can choose that instead of booking your own visit.
residence.groupNo: Your university does not apply as a group. Book your own visit on HiKorea.
residence.groupUnknown: Ask your international office whether they apply for residence cards as a group. If not, book your own visit on HiKorea.
residence.bookText: HiKorea is the government website. Hangyul can't book for you or store your HiKorea password. Book there, then come back and tell us the date.
residence.useGroup: My university is applying for me
residence.booked: Your appointment: {{when}} at {{office}}. Bring the documents below.
residence.groupFiling: Your university is filing your application. Tell us when it's submitted.
residence.waiting: Submitted. The card usually takes one to several weeks, depending on the office. Don't leave Korea while you wait unless immigration says you can.
residence.lateText: Contact your counselor today. They'll help you with the immigration office.

arrived.title: Landed safely?
arrived.text: Tell us you've arrived. We'll start your residence card countdown and show your steps for the first weeks.
arrived.confirmText: We'll record today as your arrival date. You need to apply for your residence card within 90 days.

help.title: Need help in Korea?
help.subtitle: Tell us what happened. The right person on your team gets it immediately.
help.sideText: Ask about housing, your university, visa, documents or payments in one place.
help.messageHint: A few sentences are enough. You can write in your own language.
help.sentOps: Sent. Hangyul's operations team has it.
help.medicalFirst: If it's an emergency, call 119 now
help.medicalText: For an ambulance call 119 (or 112 for police). Then tell us here so your team can help with the rest.

housing.title: Housing
housing.subtitle: Choose where you'll live. We'll guide you through the rest.
housing.quietText: Once you have an offer, you can compare the dormitory and other options here.
housing.noUniText: Housing options appear once you've accepted an offer.
housing.partnerAvail: Rooms from providers with a Hangyul agreement
housing.tempShort: A few nights or weeks while you settle
housing.settledText: Add your move-in details below so your pickup and residence card use the right address.

compare.DORM: Usually the simplest first year: on or near campus, one contract with the university, meals sometimes included. Places are limited and applications close early.
compare.OFF_CAMPUS: More choice and privacy. You need a deposit (often large) and a contract. Your counselor can review it with you before you sign.
compare.TEMPORARY: A short stay while you find a room or wait for the dormitory to open.

housing.honest: We show only dormitory facts with a source, and only rooms a provider has actually offered, each labeled. We never invent listings.
housing.dormSub: Facts from the university, with their source and when they were last checked.

dormExplain.PLANNING: Apply on the university's housing portal before the period closes, then tell us here.
dormExplain.APPLIED: The university is allocating rooms. Your team checks the result for you.
dormExplain.ASSIGNED: You've been offered a room. Pay the deposit to the university by its deadline, then confirm here.
dormExplain.CONFIRMED: Your room is confirmed. Add your move-in details below.
dormExplain.NOT_ASSIGNED: No room this time. Your counselor will help you with other options.

housing.noDorms: This university hasn't published dormitory details we can show.
housing.askedToast: Sent. Your team will arrange a viewing.

searchExplain.INTERESTED: Your team is contacting the provider to arrange a viewing (in person or by video).
searchExplain.CONTRACT_REVIEW: Your counselor is going through the contract with you. Don't pay anything yet.
searchExplain.DEPOSIT: Pay the deposit as agreed in the contract and keep the receipt.
searchExplain.CONFIRMED: Your room is confirmed. Add your move-in details below.

housing.partnerSub: Only providers with an active Hangyul agreement appear here.
housing.listingsSub: Every room comes from a named provider.
housing.noListingsText: Hangyul doesn't list rooms it can't stand behind. Your counselor can help you search, and review a contract with you before you sign.
housing.foundOwnSub: Share the contract before you sign. Your counselor checks it with you.
housing.tempSub: Your team arranges somewhere to stay for your first nights.
housing.tempRequest: Ask my team to arrange it
housing.tempRequested: Sent. Your team will suggest options.

lease.title: Contract check
lease.intro: Upload the proposed contract and fill in what you can read. Your counselor reviews it with you. We check for missing or unclear terms. This is not legal advice.
lease.sent: Sent. Your counselor will review it with you.
lease.disclaimer: This is a completeness check of what was entered, not a legal review. For legal questions, ask a licensed professional.
lease.staffDisclaimer: Automatic check of entered fields only. No legal conclusions.
lease.flagsTitle: Clear these up before you sign
lease.noFlags: All key terms are filled in. Your counselor will still go through the contract with you.

flag.UNCLEAR_DEPOSIT: The deposit amount is missing or unclear.
flag.UNCLEAR_RENT: The monthly rent is missing or unclear.
flag.UNCLEAR_DATES: The start and end dates are missing or don't make sense.
flag.MISSING_LANDLORD: Neither the landlord nor an agent is named.

profile.title: What matters to you
profile.sub: We only ask what affects your options.
profile.genderHint: Some dormitories separate floors or buildings

moveIn.title: Move-in
moveIn.sub: The details you'll need on the day.
moveIn.checkInHint: e.g. front desk with passport, door code

keys_or_code.title: Get your key or door code
keys_or_code.text: Ask who to call if you're locked out.

room_photos.title: Photograph the room
room_photos.text: Date-stamped photos of any damage protect your deposit.

meter_readings.title: Note the meter readings
meter_readings.text: Electricity, gas and water, if you pay them yourself.

deposit_receipt.title: Keep the deposit receipt
deposit_receipt.text: You'll need it to get your deposit back.

address_report.title: Report your address if you move later
address_report.text: Once you have a residence card, you must report your new address within 15 days of moving.

internet_utilities.title: Set up internet and utilities
internet_utilities.text: Check what's included in your rent.

staff.title: Services
staff.subtitle: Pickups, housing, residence cards and help requests in one queue.

empty.needs_assignment: Every new request has been picked up

staff.emptyText: New requests from students appear here.
staff.flightManual: Entered manually by the {{who}}, not live
staff.noFlight: The student hasn't added a flight.
staff.reconfirm: The student changed the flight. Confirm the pickup again with the provider.
staff.flightNotePh: e.g. airline SMS forwarded by the student
staff.noShowNote: Driver could not find the student at the meeting point.
staff.amountHint: Leave empty if not known yet
staff.noCasesText: Cases appear when the student asks for pickup, housing or help, or when you open one.

metrics.title: Service quality (last 90 days)
metrics.countsLine: {{pickups}} pickups completed · {{noShows}} no-shows · {{issues}} help requests · {{housing}} housing confirmed

vendors.title: Providers
vendors.subtitle: Drivers, housing providers, translators and other partners behind your services.
vendors.name: Name
vendors.agreementHint: Students see a provider as a Hangyul partner only while an agreement with a contract reference is active.
vendors.network: Add to the Hangyul network (visible to all agencies)
vendors.emptyText: Add the providers your team works with.
vendors.rule: Demo providers are sample data and always labelled. Suspended providers can't be assigned.
